meta.title: Payback is CAC over monthly gross profit
meta.summary: SAMPLE CAC $240, $40/mo gross profit → 6 months. Aim ≤12. Use profit after COGS, not list price.

success.message:
Session complete. CAC = all acquisition spend ÷ customers won. Payback months = CAC ÷ monthly gross profit. Aim ≤12. Not list price, and not margin twice.

SAMPLE: 36k ÷ 150 = 240; 240/40 = 6; 240/15 = 16.

cac.message:
SAMPLE: last month $21k of ads plus $15k of sales salaries won 150 customers.

CAC?

wrong_cac_ads.message:
Salespeople’s pay is acquisition cost too. Include it: $240.

Return to CAC.

wrong_cac_months.message:
CAC divides spend by customers won, not by months.

Return to CAC.

start.message:
SAMPLE: CAC $240, $40/mo gross profit after COGS.

Payback months?

wrong_start_price.message:
List price is not gross profit. Payback uses profit after COGS.

Return to GP.

wrong_start_double.message:
The $40 is already gross profit after COGS. Do not apply the margin twice: 6 months.

Return to GP.
